scope: Experimental E8 on all 40 authorized Download RAWs: D800 and X-T5 extension, D750/DNG regressions, CFA WB and isolated native delivery. No global R/SF or measured colour gate concluded.

autonomy.fuji_codec_provenance: Bounded memory-only Rust adaptation of the published Alexey Danilchenko / Alex Tutubalin LibRaw 0.22.2 Fuji codec. Source, changes, license and manifest bundled. Derived code, not clean-room; no runtime LibRaw calls or linking.
autonomy.profiles: CDDL D65 compatibility matrices with upstream Adobe attribution, not measured TrueRenderer profiles. No Adobe SDK or converter in the application.

independent_reference.xt5_calibration_reference: Original Adobe DNG retained. Explicit derivative removes only optional FixVignetteRadial (OpcodeList2, ID 3) and WarpRectilinear (OpcodeList3, ID 1). Other raw-IFD tags and stage-1 codes verified identical. Original reference used for stage 1; derivative used only for stage-2 sensor calibration. No lens-correction qualification.
independent_reference.diagnostics: SDK stdout and stderr captured separately and all diagnostic markers scanned. All unexpected warnings/errors fail; expected CFA-padding warnings are exact manifest entries.

raw_campaign.stage2_scope: Full active sensor calibration through SDK, not colour rendering accuracy.
raw_campaign.margin_scope: Adobe discards 46 rightmost D800 columns and X-T5 inactive margins. No independent sample-equivalence claim for those omitted samples; Experimental retains its full decoded sensor in RAW exports.
raw_campaign.lossy_scope: X-T5 equality is for reconstructed quantized codes. Camera quantization is irreversible.
raw_campaign.sdk_warning_scope: Four expected CFA-padding warnings on the X-T5 original reference, calibration derivative and both repacks. None on the 39 NEF reference pairs. Border demosaic is not qualified by this check.

cfa_white_balance.domain: Linearized black-subtracted CFA before gains, demosaic and colour conversion. Auto assumes grey world; explicit user action, not hidden colour correction.
cfa_white_balance.synthetic_tests: Bayer/X-Trans; eight orientations; Auto and 5x5/11x11 patches; sparse outliers; dark, clipped, out-of-range and invalid coordinates.
cfa_white_balance.limits: Fixed sensor-relative validity thresholds; not a calibrated camera noise model or measured WB accuracy. Relative parameter precision remains 0.001.

dng_regression.warning_scope: Only four exact CFA-padding warnings on each small generated fixture and X-T5 DNG/repack; none on D750 photographic DNGs. Nonempty optical opcode lists remain unsupported by the product.

other_engines.scope: Four camera/mode examples on five current engines: 15 successful developments and five expected capability refusals. Before/after comparison of the four historical engines on three NEFs: 10 successful cases and two identical refusals; 50 PNG artifacts and 10 linear crops bit-identical. D750 Experimental PNGs and linear crop also unchanged. No colour ranking from approximate, unregistered visual crops.

verification.gui_visual_inspection: D800 and X-T5 native screenshots plus overviews and 1:1 crops against AHD/Apple. No physical-display or measured colour verdict.
verification.gui_surface_scope: Visible right quarter of native viewport against CPU presentation; settings overlay and physical display excluded.
verification.post_suite_host_change: Only extension filtering in the --verify-raw-engines diagnostic to admit RAF, then fmt/Clippy/release and native comparison exercised. Decoder binaries bit-identical to the 40-file campaign.

observed_memory.scope: Read-only libproc sampling of this unique candidate host and both embedded XPCs during complete direct RAW differential campaign. Diagnostic harness retains additional comparison images; not a GUI memory budget or physical pressure qualification. Shared pages may be counted twice; brief unsampled peaks and unrelated process/driver allocations excluded.

corrections_and_negative_evidence: Pilot independent samples detected a wrong Fuji column projection; corrected with an explicit per-phase regression.
D800 DNG black is scalar zero; matching its representation removes SDK lookup-rounding differences.
Original Adobe X-T5 optional lens correction changes stage 2; calibration-only derivative is explicit, with stage 1 and remaining raw metadata verified unchanged.

Interleaved SDK stdout/stderr concealed the first warning in a line-prefix filter; capture fixed, four-warning regression checked on the actual log, full 40-RAW and eight-DNG reference campaigns repeated successfully.
remaining_limits: No measured colour targets, illuminants or independent fit/validation captures: E4, deltaE00 and noise/WB uncertainty stay open.
X-Trans interpolation is an original baseline, not qualified RI/MLRI/ARI or a superiority claim.
No D850 files; other NEF/RAF modes are not photographically qualified. X-T5 lossless codec branch lacks a real lossless sample; nonuniform black remains rejected.
Broader coverage-guided fuzzing, physical memory-pressure campaigns, Windows and release isolation assurance remain open.
